root_cause: Portal required a separate AI model choice for each workload; the attested Brain route ignored a selected tenant-wide default model when Brain override was unset. Customers could not define a single common model as desired state.
prevention_rule: Persist one tenant defaultModelId alongside optional workload overrides. Resolve strict override-first, default-second only for named workloads; then match catalog/API ID, signed proof, route, supplier status, tenant and sovereignty before any provider call. A preference never grants permission and forecast computations remain canonical.

test_evidence.status: Pending protected CI, not reported as passing prior to run

outcome.implementation: Default-model frontend and tenant routing gate code candidate
